verses.text: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

xrefs.text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

verses.text: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.

xrefs.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation? “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”
A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.

verses.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!

xrefs.text: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name— the LORD your God—
He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.

verses.text: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.

xrefs.text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.

verses.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

xrefs.text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

verses.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.

xrefs.text: Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go!
Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he splattered on the altar.

And Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a log. And when he cast it into the waters, they were sweetened. There the LORD made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there He tested them,
So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain. As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
Then the LORD said to Moses, “Why are you crying out to Me? Tell the Israelites to go forward.

verses.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.

xrefs.text: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,
See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,

The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.

verses.text: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.

xrefs.text: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.”
But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

And you, My servant Jacob, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, for I am with you. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have banished you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
Only this have I found: I have discovered that God made mankind upright, but they have sought out many schemes.”
“Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will not enter the land that I have given the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.

verses.text: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

xrefs.text: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice, and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.

And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
